title: Pokemon TCG Sinistea 089/202 Sword & Shield Reverse Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Pokémon TCG card features the elegant and rare Sinistea, with a stunning Reverse Holo finish. The card is a Standard size and made of high-quality Card Stock material, perfect for collectors and players alike. It comes from the Sword & Shield set, manufactured by Nintendo in the United States in 2021. 

The card's number is 089 and it belongs to the Pokémon type. It is suitable for players aged 4+ and is part of the English language version of the game. The card is not autographed and is not considered vintage. It is a great addition to any collection and can be found at the RareCollectorsGuild on ebay.
